hook_patterns: Interactive self-assessment ('Pick one to reveal X')
Forbidden or hidden text revelation ('The forgotten pages of X')
Metaphorical visual stories ('The psychological effect of X object')
todays_angle: Translate classic 19th-century public domain psychological principles into interactive, self-diagnostic tests for modern viewers.
ideas: The Crowd's Mirror: 3 quick visual choices based on Gustave Le Bon's 'The Crowd' to test how easily your mind succumbs to groupthink.
The Forgotten Habit Loop: A 30-second breakdown of William James' 1890 'Law of Habit' told through an animated metaphor of physical path-carving.
Freud's Slip Test: Show 3 dual-meaning optical imagery classic prints to diagnose whether the viewer's Ego or Id is currently dominating.
avoid: Generic 'Dark Psychology Facts about Men and Women' bullet-point lists with no narrative origin.
Overused high-school drama advice like 'How to act when the class laughs at you'.
